# Imports outside the domain rules, frozen by name (docs/server/architecture.md "Domain model"): "<pkg> imports
# <path>", the legacy cores' own imports outside core-import and the imports of them by the hub and db that path-no-core
# refuses ("(test)" for test files). server/internal/archguard's TestDomainLayers fails on any other such import; one
# that no longer happens prints a notice, and its line can go. Add none: with a base, the test fails on a line the
# merge base's list lacks, unless a frozen import's package or path moved (python3 scripts/test/name_freezes.py moves
# writes those).
#
# These packages predate the rules; their counts only fall; do not copy their shapes. Copy server/internal/domainkit,
# server/internal/agentref and its adapter, and the compliant twins in
# server/internal/archguard/testdata/domainrules/planted (assistant/fleetcount and its adapter), or start with
# python3 scripts/new_domain_slice.py. assistant/chatsearch depends on impure packages (prompts, transcript, lazyre, compat, proto, the
# SDK's wire and golang.org/x/text): its imports stay frozen here until it is converted.
